## Objective

Use finite models to show ancestry collapse, dominant weights and low weight-based ESS, the target-moment gap in the source test class, instability of residual offspring floors at positive integers, and the failure of proposal-density ratio bounds to control time-uniform SMC variance when proposals vary. Contrast the fixed-horizon variance growth with a bounded-weight filter contracting the closed last-state test subspace, with exact variance $1/4$. This does not assert contraction of arbitrary stored-path tests. These examples state the limits of the accompanying CLT and variance claims.
